editorial:
Imagine a kid who is basically a tiny nightmare in human form. That is exactly what you get here. You follow this brat through a day where his only goal is to cause as much chaos as possible. From ruining his parents' private moments to bothering elderly neighbors with inappropriate jokes, the movie is all about shock value and mean-spirited humor. It has a very specific, edgy vibe that feels like a comic strip come to life, where the main character is the one you love to hate because he just does not care about anyone's feelings.

The animation is simple and old-school, which actually helps the jokes land better. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored while the kid is wreaking havoc. While the humor is definitely crude and not for everyone, it is great if you enjoy dark comedy. You should definitely try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the colors pop, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick laugh. If you are a fan of weird animation, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a solid move.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up by showing that the little brat never actually learns a lesson. After a full day of terrorizing his parents and the poor Mrs. Koschmidder, he ends up right back where he started. Instead of a heartwarming change, the film closes with him planning his next move to annoy people. It is a funny, cynical ending that confirms he will always be a little monster, leaving the adults in his life completely exhausted.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves edgy humor and mean characters.
